name: Gallery
descriptor: A responsive grid of cards, each led by an image, with a caption underneath.
pros: the picture is the record, so the grid is the honest layout
lazy loading means a hundred cards still open quickly
a missing or broken image degrades to a caption, not a hole
it prints and exports the same records as any other list
cons: images are urls: nothing is embedded, so a dead link is a dead card
no upload, no cropping, no zoom, no lightbox
the grid is only as fast as the host serving the images
a record with a long caption breaks the grid rhythm
best_for: a visual index of things you already have pictures of
avoid_if: the images must be carried inside the file
